audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings tell the player to time Wither around a Lillia dash: content.mid ('Hold Wither for the exact frame she dashes in on E'), content.whys[5] ('she still dashes out of Wither on E') and content.wants.you[1] ('Land Wither (W) the instant she dashes in on E'). Lillia has no dash. Her E is Swirlseed, a rolling projectile.
audit.why: Nothing in Lillia's kit carries a dash flag. Her mobility is entirely Blooming Blows' passive — stacking Move Speed each time she hits an enemy with a spell. This inverts the advice: there is no dash frame to punish, so a Nasus holding Wither for one holds it forever. Because her speed is a stacking buff rather than a blink, Wither is a genuine hard counter to it — you just have to be willing to cast it on a normal step-in.
audit.corrected: Lillia has no dash — her kite is Blooming Blows' stacking Move Speed, which is exactly what Wither deletes. Cast it when she steps in to Watch Out! Eep!, not on a dash that does not exist.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lillia.json Q/E descriptions and flags (no dash anywhere in kit)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states the precondition on Lilting Lullaby. Both layers treat her ultimate as an unconditional sleep she can drop on you at will.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep.' Dream Dust comes from her passive, applied when one of her skills hits you. If you have not been hit by an ability, her ultimate simply does not touch you. That converts a scary unavoidable level-6 spike into a dodgeable one, and it is the single most decisive interaction in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps enemies already carrying Dream Dust from her passive — dodge her spells and her ult has nothing to land on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The file notes her passive max-health burn but never mentions that Blooming Blows deals TRUE damage on its outer edge.
audit.why: Blooming Blows deals magic damage to nearby enemies and extra true damage on the edge. Nasus's whole late-game identity is a huge health bar plus resistances; the flagged _missing-interactions entry for this matchup is exactly this. Standing at the rim of her Q is worse than standing in the middle of it, which is counter-intuitive and worth one sentence.
audit.corrected: Blooming Blows' outer ring is true damage — armour does not answer it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lillia.json Q description and trueDamage flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Lillia's W is called 'bramble' throughout (content.early 'W bramble', content.mid 'bramble-burn-bounce loop', content.whys[2] 'Her W bramble', content.late 'can't bramble away'). Its name is Watch Out! Eep!.
audit.why: Bramble is Maokai's flavour, not Lillia's. 'Can't bramble away' is doubly wrong because W is a stationary AoE with no movement component at all.
audit.corrected: Watch Out! Eep! (W) — an AoE burst around her, heaviest in the centre. No mobility.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. breakdown.cooldowns names only Blooming Blows with no number, and Blooming Blows is the wrong ability to build the lane around — it is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s and effectively always up.
audit.why: The cooldowns that actually gate her are Lilting Lullaby at 150/130/110s — the longest ultimate cooldown Nasus faces in this slice, against his own 120/100/80 — and Swirlseed at a flat 12s. Telling a player to wait out a 4-second ability is worse than telling them nothing.
audit.corrected: Lilting Lullaby 150/130/110 (your R out-cycles it at every rank). Swirlseed flat 12s. Blooming Blows bottoms out at 4s — never wait for it.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid and content.whys[2] say she chunks you 'from outside Wither range' / 'from a distance I can't answer'.
audit.why: Wither is 700. Blooming Blows is 450, Watch Out! Eep! is 500 and Swirlseed is cast at 700. Every damage tool she has is cast from inside or at the edge of Wither's range — the only thing that reaches further is a Swirlseed that misses and keeps rolling. She does not out-range Wither, she out-runs it, and that distinction is the difference between 'this is hopeless' and 'land one W and she is finished'.
audit.corrected: She out-runs Wither, she does not out-range it — her damage is all cast from 450-700.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.tldr opens 'He denies your stacks from range' and full.dosFull[2].t reads 'Wither him the moment Blooming Blows is down'. Lillia is female and the rest of the entry uses she/her.
audit.why: Small, but the file contradicts itself sentence to sentence, which reads as machine-generated and undermines trust in the numbers next to it.
48.4% over 469 games. Lillia holding six of seven stages with Nasus taking only 2+ items is a reasonable chart for a sub-50 matchup.

notes: Both packet suspectNames here ('Her Lilting Lullaby', 'Land Lilting Lullaby') are FALSE POSITIVES — correct Riot names with a leading word. The real errors were elsewhere: Lillia is given a dash she does not have in three places, her W is called 'bramble' (Maokai's word) in four, and her ultimate's Dream Dust precondition — the most important fact in the matchup — is absent from both layers. content.early still contains 'E seed and W bramble'; I left it because the surrounding sentence is otherwise accurate and I could not rename both abilities and stay inside the length band without cutting its level-1 point. Worth a second pass.
